title: Mafia Hotel
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#960, 2026-11-03), Apple M1, macOS 27.2 (entered as 272), Highball 0.10.25, engine entered as x86-sikagurir-10.0_6-r29 (most likely x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29), D3DMetal, rated 4 of 5: the Epic copy, menus only. At the game's low settings with a 60 fps cap the menus ran at 20 to 25 fps, and getting past Epic's check of the game to the title screen took a long time. Not played in a match, which needs a room of players. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reached the menus in one report on an M1 with D3DMetal, the Epic copy, at 20 to 25 fps on low settings. It's a multiplayer game and wasn't played in a match.
